input: Shinn et al. (2023) describe Reflexion as natural-language policy optimization: the agent turns a feedback signal from each trial into reflective text and keeps it in a long-term memory limited to a sliding window. For code generation the feedback comes from unit tests, and the authors note that test-driven development is hard for non-deterministic or impure functions. Critique a claim that Reflexion makes any agent improve steadily across trials, whatever the quality of its feedback signal.
source: Shinn et al. 2023, Abstract and Limitations (chunks shinn2023-000, shinn2023-023)
